title: Card 5: har service ka apna group, apna offset. Alag group = sabko poori khabar. Nayi service = naya group

boxes.title: Nayi service
lines: bas naya group, producer kuch nahi badalta
offset? shuru se ya ab se

callouts.red: Teeno service ek hi team (group) me daal dete?
callouts.green: Team me har khabar ek hi member ko jaati: sirf Email ko mila, Analytics aur Dashboard ko kuch nahi

callouts.red: Pehle poochho: ek khabar kai service ko jaani hai, ya kisi ek ko?
callouts.green: Ye sawaal poora design badalta. Kai service ko = har service ki alag team

callouts.red: Dashboard dheema hai, abhi 95 pe atka
callouts.green: Email nahi rukta, wo 100 pe hai. Har team ka bookmark alag, koi kisi ka intezaar nahi karta

kyun: Har service ki apni team (group) aur apna bookmark (offset). Isliye Email, Analytics, Dashboard teeno ko Arpan ka poora order milta, aur koi dheema ho to baaki nahi rukte
ab: Arpan ka order analytics aur dashboard ko bhi chahiye
agla: ab machine hi mar gayi to? (card 6)
